per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to simple booking requests within five seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have a familiar and intuitive navigation layout, including a clear top bar with options such as Home, Calendar, Bookings, and Profile.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall use a standard navigation menu familiar to most web users.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow users to start using it successfully without training within fifteen minutes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'An employee will be able to successfully use the product within a few minutes. After informally navigating the product for less than 15 minutes users shall be able to successfully setup meetings and reserve conference rooms.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide accurate search results and functional filters to help users quickly find suitable rooms.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow for intuitive searching of available conference rooms.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be accessible to users with disabilities, including support for screen readers, keyboard navigation, high contrast, and large fonts.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should display dates and times in the local format for users in different regions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall be able to display calendar dates and times according to the user's locale. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the date and time formatting of the product is correct.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be highly available during work hours, with minimal downtime.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be compatible with the different email servers used by the organization.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'
